verdict.rationale: Accepting and scanning service of process is a core axis for a registered agent, so the story applies. The evidence pack contains no first-party or independent evidence about a street office or same-day scanning: the site's robots.txt returned a Cloudflare challenge, so nothing was fetched. The only community item is unrelated to service of process.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, service of process is accepted at a real street office and scanned into my account the same day it is received
